events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with potential implications for global oil prices and geopolitical stability. The US and its allies are considering further military action, while Iran has vowed to retaliate. The conflict has already led to a significant increase in oil prices and volatility in the stock market.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war has the potential to significantly impact global oil prices and geopolitical stability. As a result, investors may seek safe-haven assets such as the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, while oil and gas exploration and production stocks may decline.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and geopolitical developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit if oil prices decline by 10% or if a ceasefire is announced

events.title: Fed Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The Federal Reserve is considering an interest rate hike to combat rising inflation. The decision will have significant implications for the US economy and stock market.
events.reasoning: An interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve would likely lead to a decline in long-term bond prices and an increase in short-term bond prices. As a result, investors may seek to buy short-term bond ETFs and short long-term bond ETFs.

timeFrame.note: Monitor inflation data and Fed statements

events.exitStrategy: Exit if the Fed decides not to hike interest rates

gains.conservativeNote: If the rate hike is modest
gains.extendedNote: If the rate hike is larger than expected
